newsitem.title: USA: Pillsbury sets Chinese dumplings venture.
newsitem.headline: Pillsbury sets Chinese dumplings venture.

text.p: Pillsbury, a subsidiary of Grand Metropolitan Plc, said Thursday it formed a joint venture for the manufacture, distribution and sale of Chinese dumplings in Hong Kong and Southern China.
Terms of the transaction, which have been negotiated with the shareholders of Lady Chong's Peking Dumpling Ltd, were not disclosed.
Pillsbury will have the majority interest in the joint venture.

"The total Hong Kong retail dumpling category is substantial and growing," Lucio Rizzi, president of Pillsbury International, said in a statement, "and we feel this acquisition complements our other dough-based businesses around the world. More importantly, this joint venture provides us with an additional entry vehicle into China."
